measurement.method: summed live device weight tensors deduplicated by buffer address; KV and GDN state from the decoder's own state_shapes() at TP=8; byte-per-element from ttnn.tile_size (bfloat4_b 0.5625, bfloat8_b 1.0625, float32 4.0)

capacity_evidence.note: Only 16 of 64 layers hold a paged KV cache; the 48 linear_attention layers hold a fixed-size recurrent and convolution state that does not grow with context.
capacity_evidence.shared_pool_derivation: max = (state_budget_remaining - gdn_recurrent_and_conv_per_request * (1 + MAX_PREFIX_SNAPSHOTS)) // kv_cache_per_page * 32 = 26552 pages = 849664 tokens at batch 1, with MAX_PREFIX_SNAPSHOTS = 16. Serving reserves the snapshot store unconditionally because the pool is sized once at startup and cannot give the memory back later; without that reserve the same budget holds 27657 pages = 885024 tokens. The recommended 458752 is not a capacity result. Capacity is not what fails: the prefill startup warmup aborts with 98.4 MiB per bank free and no contiguous block above 50.8 MiB, against a single pass asking 53.3 MiB per bank (16 rows x 4096 tokens x 5120 x bf16 = 640 MiB across 12 banks). Every observed abort factors exactly as rows x 4096 x 5120 x bf16 from _warm_occupancies, inside minimal_matmul at linear_attn.out_proj; no allocation of max-num-batched-tokens was ever observed, and the earlier derivation that cited one was wrong. QWEN_PREFILL_PASS_TOKENS now bounds a pass to 8 rows = 26.7 MiB per bank, which is what lets capacity 16 reach readiness. 458752 was chosen while the failure was still attributed to warmup size, and has not been re-measured since the pass cap landed: 525312, two full contexts plus 1024, is the value to re-test before 458752 is treated as a ceiling. Note the batch delta measures 44.7 MiB per slot against the 18.35 MiB gdn_recurrent_and_conv_per_request recorded above, which is unreconciled and leaves shared_pool_tokens_max_that_fits optimistic by about 7%.

limiting_reason: none for single-request context; the binding constraint is the shared paged pool across concurrent requests, not the per-request context
outstanding_verification: An end-to-end 262144-token run has not been executed on this mesh; the figure above is a capacity result, not a latency or quality result.
